query.text:
select a.ma_phi, a.ten_phi, a.ten_phi2, a.ma_dvt, b.ten_dvt, a.nhom_bg1, c.ten_nh ten_nh1, a.nhom_bg2, d.ten_nh ten_nh2, a.nhom_bg3, e.ten_nh ten_nh3, IIF(a.fcl_yn = 1, replace(a.fcl_yn,1,'x'), '') fcl_yn, IIF(a.fcl2_yn = 1, replace(a.fcl2_yn,1,'x'), '') fcl2_yn, IIF(a.fcl2_yn = 1, replace(a.fcl3_yn,1,'x'), '') fcl3_yn,
IIF(a.lcl_yn = 1, replace(a.lcl_yn,1,'x'), '') lcl_yn, IIF(a.lcl2_yn = 1, replace(a.lcl2_yn,1,'x'), '') lcl2_yn, IIF(a.lcl2_yn = 1, replace(a.lcl3_yn,1,'x'), '') lcl3_yn,
IIF(a.air_yn = 1, replace(a.air_yn,1,'x'), '') air_yn, IIF(a.air2_yn = 1, replace(a.air2_yn,1,'x'), '') air2_yn, IIF(a.air2_yn = 1, replace(a.air3_yn,1,'x'), '') air3_yn,
IIF(a.cdi_yn = 1, replace(a.cdi_yn,1,'x'), '') cdi_yn, IIF(a.cdi2_yn = 1, replace(a.cdi2_yn,1,'x'), '') cdi2_yn, IIF(a.cdi3_yn = 1, replace(a.cdi3_yn,1,'x'), '') cdi3_yn,
IIF(a.cdn_yn = 1, replace(a.cdn_yn,1,'x'), '') cdn_yn, IIF(a.cdn_yn = 1, replace(a.cdn2_yn,1,'x'), '') cdn2_yn, IIF(a.cdn_yn = 1, replace(a.cdn3_yn,1,'x'), '') cdn3_yn, IIF(a.status = '1', N'Còn sử dụng', N'Không sử dụng') status from dmphi a with(nolock) left join dmdvt b on a.ma_dvt = b.dvt left join dmnh c on a.nhom_bg1 = c.ma_nh left join dmnh d on a.nhom_bg2 = d.ma_nh left join dmnh e on a.nhom_bg3 = e.ma_nh where ma_phi = @ma_phi
